items.source: By default, this method returns new line "\n" if the given mime type is one of the configured streaming mime types.
items.translation: 默认情况下，如果给定的 MIME 类型是配置的streamingMIME 类型之一，此方法将返回换行符"\n"。

items.source: Construct a new instance with the provided builder customized with the JacksonModules found by MapperBuilder.findModules(ClassLoader) and MimeTypes.
items.translation: 使用由 `MapperBuilder.findModules(ClassLoader)` 查找到的 `JacksonModule` 和 `MimeType` 定制的提供的 `builder` 构建新实例。

items.source: Return the list of MIME types supported by this Encoder. The list may not apply to every possible target element type and calls to this method should typically be guarded via canEncode(elementType, null). The list may also exclude MIME types supported only for a specific element type. Alternatively, use Encoder.getEncodableMimeTypes(ResolvableType) for a more precise list.
items.translation: 返回此编码器支持的 MIME 类型列表。该列表可能不适用于所有可能的目标元素类型，因此调用此方法时通常应通过 canEncode(elementType, null) 进行保护。该列表也可能仅包含特定元素类型支持的 MIME 类型。或者，使用 Encoder.getEncodableMimeTypes(ResolvableType) 获取更精确的列表。

items.source: Base class providing support methods for Jackson 3.x encoding. For non-streaming use cases, Flux elements are collected into a List before serialization for performance reasons.
items.translation: 提供 Jackson 3.x 编码支持方法的基类。对于非流式使用场景，出于性能考虑，在序列化之前会将 Flux 元素收集到 List 中。
